description: This file defines the CohereEmbedding_Embeddings class implementing the INode interface, which integrates Cohere API embeddings into a larger system. It includes methods for loading models and initializing the embedding model with credentials and parameters.

classes.name: CohereEmbedding_Embeddings
classes.description: A class implementing INode to provide Cohere API embedding functionalities within the system.

methods.name: loadMethods.listModels
methods.description: Asynchronously loads available embedding models from Cohere.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Cohere embedding model with credentials and user-specified parameters.
